messages:
Nora (mktg ops): Quick flag — noticing a mismatch between the launch post benchmark slide and the live funnel viz for the past 2 weeks. Looks like social traffic converts to demo at a different rate than webinar traffic.
Liam (analytics): Confirmed. Benchmark sheet shows social cohort CR 2.8% but live dashboard shows 1.9% for same cohort window.
Tara (demand): Could this be sampling? Which metric are we comparing — first-touch or session-based conversions?
Liam (analytics): Benchmarks are first-touch attribution (7d window). Live funnel is session-based (30d). That explains part of it.
Nora (mktg ops): Ugh. We should standardize for the KPI review. Want a single number that leadership can trust.
Ben (creative): Also saw previews of the launch post creative — the CTA copy changed between social and landing. Possible creative drift.
Liam (analytics): Quick SQL I used: ```SELECT cohort, sum(is_demo) / count(distinct user_id) as cr FROM events WHERE cohort_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-14' GROUP BY 1```
Nora (mktg ops): Ops-bot: "ops-bot: dataset sync complete (uid: 20260321-x)."
Tara (demand): Proposal: add a "momentum" row to the KPI deck that shows (1) standardized CR by attribution window, (2) creative variant label, (3) demo CTAs clicked per 1k sessions. That will call out when benchmarks and live are out of sync.
Liam (analytics): I can add a toggle on the Viz for 7/14/30 day windows and compute first vs last touch. Also include small table showing sample sizes so leads with tiny n don't skew the benchmark.
Ben (creative): I'll pull the creative matrix and tag each social post with the CTA variant used.
Nora (mktg ops): For the weekly KPI review, include: one slide with the benchmark vs live split, one slide with creative mapping, and a recommended 2-week test for the low-performing social CTA.
Tara (demand): If landing messaging is the issue, we should run an immediate copy swap and measure demo CTA CTR over the next 72 hours for the webinar drip and launch post cohorts.
Liam (analytics): Timeline: Viz changes today by EOD, momentum slide draft by tomorrow AM, creative mapping by Ben by tomorrow noon.
ops-bot: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am — calendar invite posted to #marketing."
Nora (mktg ops): Action items recap: Liam — add attribution toggle + sample-size column; Ben — creative tagging; Tara — rapid copy swap plan; I'll consolidate slide and add a footnote about data sources (GA4 vs HubSpot).
Ben (creative): Got it. I'll also add screenshots so we can point to exact message copy.
Tara (demand): One more ask: can we benchmark webinar registrant behavior vs organic social by time-to-convert? Might reveal delayed conversion that 7d windows miss.
Liam (analytics): Will add time-to-convert dist curve to the appendix.
Nora (mktg ops): Perfect — see you at the KPI sync. Appreciate quick turn on this. :rocket:
